title: Quarter Volume Library Prep Step 6: Clean Up
author: Opentrons
materials: The protocol will alert the user to ensure reagents are present on deck in sufficient volume.

steps.title: Set magnetic engage height
steps.instruction: Enter the engage height for the custom labware on the magnetic module as a protocol parameter before starting the run.

steps.title: Confirm reagent volumes
steps.instruction: Verify that all required reagents are loaded on the deck in sufficient volume; the protocol will alert you if any are missing.

steps.title: Dispense beads and mix
steps.instruction: Using the P300 multi‑channel pipette, dispense the magnetic beads into each well of the magnetic module plate and mix the contents.

steps.title: Incubate and discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate for 5 minutes, then engage the magnets and use the P300 multi‑channel pipette to remove the supernatant from each well and discard it into the liquid waste.

steps.title: Wash beads with ethanol
steps.instruction: Wash the bead pellets twice with 80 % ethanol using the P300 multi‑channel pipette.

substeps.instruction: First wash: add 80 % ethanol, mix, remove supernatant.
Second wash: repeat the addition of 80 % ethanol, mix, remove supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend beads and incubate
steps.instruction: After air‑drying the beads, resuspend each pellet in 0.1× TE buffer with the P20 multi‑channel pipette, incubate for 2 minutes, then re‑engage the magnets.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend in 0.1× TE using P20 multi‑channel pipette.
